text: Upload PDFs, websites, YouTube videos, audio files, Google Docs, or Google Slides as notebook sources, or discover new sources
quote: Easily upload PDFs, websites, YouTube videos, audio files, Google Docs, or Google Slides or discover new sources.

text: Supports uploading Word, text, Markdown, PDF, CSV, and PowerPoint files as sources
quote: Microsoft Word (docx), Text (txt), Markdown (md), PDF files (pdf), CSV (csv), and PowerPoint (pptx) files

text: Each source can hold up to 500,000 words, and uploaded files can be up to 200MB
quote: Each source can contain up to 500,000 words or up to 200MB for uploaded files.

text: Add eligible Google Play ebooks as sources; only text content is supported
quote: Play Books: Add eligible ebooks from Google Play as sources in Gemini Notebook. At this time, only text is supported.

text: Share a website, PDF, or YouTube video directly from your device into a notebook
quote: Share content directly to Gemini Notebook when viewing a website, PDF, or YouTube video on your device.

text: Chat with a notebook to get answers grounded in your sources, with inline citations
quote: Chat with your notebook to get grounded information based on your sources with clear in-line citations for accuracy, transparency, and trust.

text: Hover over a citation to see the full quoted text
quote: You can hover over any citation to get the full quoted text right away.

text: Selecting a citation jumps to the quote's location in the source so you can read it in context
quote: If you select a citation, Gemini Notebook automatically navigates to the location of the quote, so you can easily view it in context.

text: Choose which sources in the notebook the model uses to answer questions
quote: Select which sources in your notebook the model should use to answer your questions.

text: Auto-generated summary of each entire source shown in the Source Guide
quote: Find an auto-generated summary of the entire source in the Source Guide.

text: Pick a conversational style for chat: Default, or Custom with a specified style or role
quote: Select a conversational style. Default: Best for general purpose research and brainstorming tasks... Custom: Best for choosing a specific style

text: Generate reports in FAQ, study guide, or briefing format, an AI-suggested type, or a custom format
quote: Create your own, or choose from FAQ, study guide, briefing document, or an AI suggested report type.

text: Audio Overviews: AI hosts hold deep-dive discussions that summarize the key topics in your sources
quote: Audio Overviews are deep-dive discussions between AI hosts that provide in-depth summaries of the key topics in your uploaded sources.

text: Audio Overview formats include Deep Dive, The Brief, and The Debate for exploring multiple perspectives
quote: Choose a format. Deep Dive (default) for an in-depth conversation... The Brief for a quick overview... The Debate for exploring multiple perspectives.

text: Critique audio format: two hosts give constructive evaluation of material such as an essay or design doc
quote: The Critique for critical feedback. Two hosts provide a constructive evaluation of material like an essay or design doc.

text: Download Audio Overviews for offline playback
quote: Listen to Audio Overviews on the go and download them for offline playback.

text: Video Overviews turn notebook sources into a video summary
quote: Video Overviews transform the sources in your notebook into an engaging video. They distill complex information into clear, digestible content, providing a comprehensive and engaging visual deep dive of your material.

text: Mind Maps show sources as a branching diagram of main topics and related ideas
quote: Mind Maps in Gemini Notebook visually summarize your uploaded sources, showing main topics and related ideas as a branching diagram.

text: Select a Mind Map node to ask chat questions about that specific topic
quote: Select nodes to ask questions: Directly select a node in the Mind Map to ask questions in the Gemini Notebook chat about that specific topic.

text: Generate flashcards or quizzes from your sources as interactive study aids
quote: Flashcards or Quizzes help you master your material by turning information from your sources into interactive study aids.

text: Set flashcard or quiz difficulty to easy, medium, or hard
quote: Select the difficulty: Choose between easy, medium, and hard.

text: Download flashcards as a CSV file
quote: Download your flashcards as a CSV file.

text: Generate infographics that condense source information into a single visual summary
quote: Infographics turn complex information from your sources into a single, engaging visual summary.

text: Choose an infographic visual style such as Sketch Note, Kawaii, or Professional (18+ users only)
quote: Choose a visual style (only for 18+ users), such as Sketch Note, Kawaii, Professional, etc.

text: Rename, share, delete, or download an infographic as a PNG file
quote: Use the three dots menu next to your generated Infographic to rename, download as a PNG file, share, or delete.

text: Generate a slide deck from your sources, present it in the app, or share it as a PDF
quote: Transform your sources into a polished presentation by generating a Slide Deck, perfect for sharing or reviewing key concepts. Present your deck instantly in Gemini Notebook or share it as a PDF.

text: Make a notebook public and share a link with anyone who has a Google account
quote: You can make your notebook public and share a link with anyone with a Google account.

text: Owners of public notebooks on paid subscriptions can view usage analytics
quote: Owners of public notebooks with paid subscriptions can view usage analytics in the analytics tab.

text: Use notes to capture and organize insights from sources and add your own thoughts
quote: You can use notes to capture and organize information, identify key insights and interpretations from your sources, and add your own thoughts.

text: Save chat responses as notes, keeping tables and clickable inline citations
quote: When you save a response as a note, the original format—including tables and clickable inline citations—gets saved.

text: Notes appear as sources and can be used in Q&A, cited in chat answers, and included in generated artifacts
quote: Created notes automatically appear in the Sources panel alongside your uploaded sources. This means your notes can be used for Q&A, cited in Chat responses, and included in artifact generation.

text: Convert a single note into a source
quote: To convert a single note to a source: Open the note. Select Convert to source.

text: Export notes to Google Docs or Google Sheets
quote: You can export your notes to Google Docs or Google Sheets.

text: Available as a core service for Google Workspace and Workspace for Education users
quote: For Workspace and Workspace for Education users, Gemini Notebook is now a core service (like Gmail, Google Calendar, and Docs).

text: When you are out of AI limits, you can delay generations to run later
quote: When you are out of AI limits, you can now delay generations for later.
